text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer must take seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. Authentication systems must be strong, with secure passwords and features like two-factor authentication. Developers also need to validate all user input carefully to prevent attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, can seriously damage a website if they are ignored. By following good security practices and staying informed about new threats, developers can protect both their applications and their users from harm.
